title: [Bug] Claude Code hangs without response since v2.0.60
body:
**Bug Description**
It hangs regularly since 2.0.60 . It looks like it's still working but just doesn't do anything for minutes. Tried restarting and everything.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 2.0.60
- Feedback ID: 864dad47-8a98-4fb3-9ad5-95b97aba8109
